description.fun: Durant are steel-armoured ants that dig nests through mountains, using mandibles strong enough to crunch through rock to build mazes of interconnected tunnels. Each member of the colony plays its own role in driving off Heatmor, their natural predator, and they work together to protect the eggs laid deep inside. It may be modelled on trap-jaw ants, or on silver ants for its gleaming colour. Ken Sugimori designed it alongside Heatmor.
description.guide: Durant is a Bug- and Steel-type ant Pokémon that lives in colonies, digging maze-like tunnels with powerful mandibles. Its natural predator is Heatmor. It does not evolve.
description.tagline: Steel-armoured ants that dig maze-like nests through mountains.
